decisions.reason: Glossary binds 전서응 as "messenger eagle"; BASE "hawk" violates it.
Captures 에도 ("even the Jin Family") and avoids BASE's redundant "messenger birds"; equally faithful and smoother.
BASE keeps the 목소리 beat but uses the wrong bird term; SOL fixes the term but drops the voice that stopped him.
decisions.replacement: Just as I was about to approach the messenger eagle, Wolhwa's voice stopped me.

decisions.reason: Turns 진 공자 into natural direct address and stays faithful; BASE's mid-clause "Young Master Jin" is stiffer.
혹시 is a dawning guess; BASE's questioning "could it be?" matches the source's question better than SOL's trailing ellipsis.
Glossary term "messenger eagle" used correctly.
Names the pouch as the beak's target, matching 주머니; clearer antecedent, same meaning.
SOL naturalizes 그 틈에 well but drops 어느새 ("already, unnoticed"); BASE keeps it but uses "hawk".
decisions.replacement: While it was distracted, a Lower District Sect member who had already slipped outside untied the cylinder bound to its ankle.

decisions.reason: Renders 지부장님 앞으로 as direct address to Wolhwa, which suits a report spoken to her; BASE's third-person "the Branch Leader" is odd in dialogue.
오묘하다 is unreadable/subtle; "inscrutable" fits better than BASE's vague "complicated".
잠시 후 means "after a moment"; BASE's "it took a while" overstates, and "finally" is an addition.
Korean says only 생각 이상 (beyond expectations); SOL's "formidable" adds an unsupported specific quality.
More natural verb phrasing, same meaning.
Cleaner flow; "hanging back" matches 쭈뼛거리던 as well as BASE's "hesitating".
Glossary 고원 → Gaoyuan, and the letter text as a blockquote suits non-System quotation convention; BASE's "plateau" loses the place name.
Preserves 한 줄 ("single line") and reads more precisely.
"closed the distance" is idiomatic and keeps the "that much, or more" sense.
More natural phrasing; 기동력 rendered acceptably as speed of advance.
Northern region → "the north" is more natural in dialogue with no loss.
Reads more smoothly; same content.
Second sentence is more idiomatic than BASE's flat "I don't know whether...though".
More natural sentence order; 돌연 preserved as "abruptly".

Tighter and smoother; "eyes" is the natural collocation for 시선.
"turned twenty" is the natural rendering of 약관을 넘겼다.
Only difference is someone/anyone; genuinely indistinguishable.
한몫 단단히 챙겨 주다 is a solid cut/share; SOL's "make a fortune" intensifies and embellishes.
끌어모은 has the scrape-together edge "gathered" keeps; "recruited" sanitizes it, and BASE's "so" matches the 구나 realization.
it's/that's all right is genuinely indistinguishable.
SOL deletes the dismissive 뭘 ("what would be the point?"), losing a rhetorical beat.
Korean line 91 is its own nominal paragraph identifying the speaker; merging it into the action (SOL) removes the dramatic beat.
Source separates the identification from the stabbing sentence; BASE preserves that structure.
"Thunk" is the established, more natural English stab-sound; "Thnk" is a nonstandard respelling.
Reordered sentence reads more naturally while keeping First Rate, One Strike, and the puppet image.
BASE keeps both 경악과 공포 ("horror and fear") and the pressure of 짓눌렀다; SOL drops "fear" and weakens "pressed down".
BASE preserves 피분수 ("fountain of blood") and the wet blood-choked sound; SOL flattens both.
선홍빛은 밝고 선명한 붉은색; "bright-red" is closer than "crimson", and the participial phrasing flows.
있는 사실 그대로 = "exactly as the facts are"; SOL's "nothing but the truth" shifts to an oath formula and adds "us".
Normalizes doubled ellipsis to the project's single … convention.
learned/had learned is genuinely indistinguishable.
"there wasn't a moment to lose" is a natural rendering of 한시가 급하다, and the em-dash listing reads smoothly.

"saddled her horse" is a concise natural equivalent of 말안장을 올리며.
"To be honest" vs "Honestly" is genuinely indistinguishable.
Source keeps 그녀도 무림인이라는 사실을 as one sentence; SOL's merge matches it and reads better.
"couldn't be sure" correctly makes Taekyung the uncertain subject.
Uses glossary "Shanxi Province" and mirrors 뜻이다 with "meant she possessed".
BASE keeps the source's two-sentence punch (그것도 ... 간단하게) as an emphatic fragment; SOL flattens it into one clause.
우두머리를 상대로 보여 준 모습 is a display against the leader (BASE); SOL's "treatment of their leader" is vaguer, and BASE's "fear of death was even greater" matches 그 이상이다.
벼랑 끝 (cliff's edge) image and 쏟아 내다 ("pour out") are preserved in BASE; SOL drops the cliff.
술술 불었을 = would have spilled it all; SOL's "talked" weakens.
닦아도 끝이 없네 = "no end, even when I wipe it"; SOL's "won't come off" changes the meaning.
streaming/running is genuinely indistinguishable, and 주르륵 suits "streaming".
Dropping "to her" loses nothing since "held out" implies the recipient, and it reads more cleanly.
SOL omits 닦으시오 ("to wipe it off"), a genuine deletion.
Word order difference only; genuinely indistinguishable.
마침 딱 필요했는데 = exactly what I needed; BASE's flat "I needed it" loses that.
"He said that, but he looked awfully pleased with himself" naturalizes 말과는 달리 and 뿌듯해 better than BASE's "His expression...looked quite pleased".
Adverb placement only; genuinely indistinguishable.
wiping away/off and out/open are genuinely indistinguishable.
BASE keeps 전역 and 아마 and 돌파 but omits glossary "Province"; SOL has Province but drops 전역, 아마, and softens 돌파 to "passed".
decisions.replacement: This is a rough map covering all of Shanxi Province. We're here. The Red Wind Band has probably… If they've been moving without rest, they may already have broken through Datong.

decisions.reason: 저희보다 빠르군요 = "they're faster than us"; SOL's "ahead of us" shifts speed to position.
관도 = official roads, more precise than "roads", and "should be able to" matches 충분히 ... 있을 거예요.
Matches 뜻이다 as the narrator's stated conclusion and reads cleaner.
"vaulted into the saddle" is the idiomatic equivalent of 훌쩍 뛰어올랐다.
일이 터지다 = trouble breaks out; SOL's rendering is idiomatic where BASE's "something always happen" is flat.
한숨이 나왔지만 is an actual sigh (SOL), while 한두 번 고생 is the explicit "first ... or second" (BASE); each version preserves only one.
decisions.replacement: I sighed inwardly, but what could I do? This wasn't my first hardship—or my second. By now I just had to accept it.

decisions.reason: Normalizes doubled ellipsis to the project's single … convention.
Terse "Not anymore, I guess." matches the deadpan 이젠 아니구나 better than BASE's explicit restatement.
Korean deliberately doubles 감시하는 동시에 관찰했다; BASE preserves that odd double verb where SOL collapses it to "took in".
every last one / every last one of them is genuinely indistinguishable.
커다란 is "large"; SOL's "sprawling" adds unsupported specificity.
Reordering to name Pung Yang first reads more naturally while keeping the hill and the silence beat.
He is a mounted bandit who later rides off, so "ridden up" is apt; "climbed" is odd for a horseman.
Glossary 고원 → Gaoyuan; BASE's "plateau" violates it.

Same glossary correction to Earth Tiger Band.

Both are natural renderings of 그랬던가; genuinely indistinguishable.

Uses glossary Gaoyuan and naturalizes the 그런데 말이야 opener and 어땠을지 모르지만 construction.
take priority / come first is genuinely indistinguishable.
Korean deliberately repeats 명심, 또 명심; SOL's "be sure to remember" flattens the comic repetition.
Glossary Gaoyuan used correctly, and "Would you go and tell them what I want?" renders 전해 줄 수 있겠나 naturally.
존명 is a formal obedience phrase; "Your command is my law" matches the sycophant's pompous register better than BASE's flat "Understood".
마적답지 않게 (unbandit-like) is preserved as the comic contrast in BASE; SOL drops it.
go on / off you go is genuinely indistinguishable.
The source's onomatopoeia 쉭 begins the sentence; setting it as a sound-effect line follows the project's existing convention (*Thud.*, *Whoosh! Slash!*).
With the whoosh carried by the sound line, this reads cleanly and keeps ten jang with its meter gloss.
푹! 털썩. is two sounds; SOL gives both (Thnk/Thud) while BASE renders 털썩 as the mismatched "Clatter".
"Clatter" mistranslates the body-slump 털썩, already covered by "Thud" in H096.
"kept galloping" is the idiomatic rendering of 계속해서 내달렸다.
Flows better as the trailing 모른 채 clause and keeps already-dead rider, caught foot, and battered body.
burn the place / burn the place down is genuinely indistinguishable.
BASE uses the pronoun "he" after naming Pung Yang in the previous sentence, while SOL repeats the name twice in one sentence.
Korean is the bare label 항산검문 대동지부, matching SOL's terse reveal form.
BASE keeps the 순간이었다 ("the moment") structure but uses "plateau" against glossary; SOL has Gaoyuan but drops "the moment".
decisions.replacement: It was the moment the Red Wind Band crossed Gaoyuan once more.

decisions.reason: 숨이 턱 막혔다 is breath catching, and SOL matches the source's cause-effect order (report → left breathless); BASE's "speechless" and reversed structure drift.
돌파 is "broke through", and the military sense of a destroyed branch fits; SOL's "passed" flattens it.
경계를 위해 나가 있던 does not say they were sent; BASE's "went out to stand guard" avoids that inference.
Korean deliberately repeats 전멸 twice; SOL keeps the repetition and matches the word where BASE's "Everyone." changes it.
BASE keeps the single protest sentence with the 터인데...어찌 connective; SOL's split loosens it.
다른 마적단 alone does not establish plurality; BASE's singular "another group" is the safer reading and its number phrasing is tighter.
그 말이 사실인가 asks whether the report is true; BASE's "Is that certain?" keeps "that" as the subject rather than shifting to the speaker.
without a doubt / there's no doubt is genuinely indistinguishable.
Korean retains 예상됩니다 ("we expect"); BASE keeps that hedge where SOL drops it.
크게 다르지 않았다 = "not much different"; SOL's "echoed" compresses and slightly strengthens.
중진 is "senior figures"; BASE's rendering is closer than SOL's "senior members".
자신 있어 asks about his confidence, not whether they can win; BASE is closer.
Comma placement only; genuinely indistinguishable.
BASE renders the rank list as natural English prose; SOL's three clipped fragments read choppily.
그 위치 = "that position" (BASE), while SOL generalizes to "such a position".
한때는, 말이다 sits in the same paragraph as its setup in the source; BASE keeps the echo in place instead of splitting it out.
The curse targets the sect itself (대항산검문), which BASE misrenders as "being a commander of"; "my ass" (SOL) substitutes a stronger, imageless slur for the mild 얼어 죽을.
decisions.replacement: To hell with the great Mount Heng Sword Sect. What good is a promotion now, with the sect in this state?

지금의 ("what it was now") and 이 사태 ("this situation") are both preserved in BASE.
이미 ("already") is authorial emphasis in 혈랑검 이천백은 이미 죽고 없다; BASE keeps it.
"some little girl" carries the contempt of 어린 계집 more than SOL's plain "a little girl".
Mirrors 누군가 ... 그 순간 as a fragment that runs straight into 쾅!, matching the source's build-up.
closed / shut is genuinely indistinguishable.
